audience: ML engineers and researchers who rent GPU servers on Lambda Cloud

useCases.title: See running instances with region and status
useCases.text: The AI lists your GPU instances with name, IP, status, region, instance type and attached filesystems, and opens one for full details.

useCases.title: Find a GPU type that is available now
useCases.text: The AI lists instance types with vCPUs, memory, GPUs, hourly price and the regions that have capacity. It compares them and picks a fit for you.

useCases.title: Launch GPU instances
useCases.text: The AI launches one or more instances in a region with an instance type and one SSH key name that you give. Billing starts when the instance boots.

useCases.title: Restart, rename, tag or terminate instances
useCases.text: The AI reboots instances, changes an instance's name or tags, or terminates instances by id. Terminating destroys non-persistent data.

useCases.title: Review firewall rules and recent account actions
useCases.text: The AI lists inbound firewall rules and rulesets, and the audit events of the account in a time window. You see the rules in place and recent actions.
